title: KinderCare Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: First Quarter Highlighted by Early Progress on Marketing and Execution Initiatives, and Strength in Champions and B2B Management Raises Full-Year Outlook. KinderCare Learning Companies, Inc. (NYSE: KLC) (“KinderCare,” the “Company,” and “we”), a leading provider of high-quality early childhood education, today announced financial results for the first quarter ended April 4, 2026.
